items.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
items.excerpt: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro: instead of retrying one general-purpose editor, it picks the right specialized tool for each step.
items.rationale: New Adobe Research system (EditAgent) shows where agentic image editing in Photoshop-class tools is heading: picking a specialized tool for each step instead of re-rolling one generator.

items.title: The Role of UX in Agentic Software Factories
items.excerpt: AI-native software development lifecycles reduce UX to 'AI context'; NN/g argues UX must discover user needs, shape what's built, and evaluate it before and after launch.
items.rationale: A credible UX research outlet sets out where designers fit when agents write the software: discovery, shaping and evaluation. Directly changes how teams staff AI-native builds.

items.title: Allplan Max 2027 launched for engineering workflows
items.excerpt: Nemetschek's Allplan Max 2027 brings AI into BIM engineering tools: Feature Builder, Workflow Builder, AI Formula Writer, AI BIM Analyst, AI Structural Analyst, AI Drafter, AI Visualizer and more, on the Nemetschek Intelligence Platform.
items.rationale: Concrete product release: a major BIM suite ships a set of AI drafting, analysis and visualization tools. A different product from the Snaptrude Agent card published 10-30.

items.title: How to design transparent AI cost controls
items.excerpt: A practical guide to choosing usage units, designing spending limits and explaining AI costs before, during and after the work, since a quick edit and a long-running agent look identical in today's interfaces.
items.rationale: Actionable pattern guide (usage units, spend limits, cost explanation) for a problem every AI product designer now ships. No earlier card in the section covered AI cost UX.

items.title: Boris FX releases Continuum 2027
items.excerpt: The effects plugin suite adds a 3D noise generator and 2D titling tool, and updates its AI masking tools: Face ML now follows the full face shape, Matte Refine ML preserves hair detail, Witness Protection ML uses precise masks.
items.rationale: New version release with upgraded ML masking (Face ML, Matte Refine ML, Witness Protection ML) that motion and VFX designers can use right away. Second render pick, so it takes a palette accent.
